name: Kaya 0.1.12
changelog: The About screen now shows the real installed version, so every update is visible on the phone.

history.1: First build: offline board, full rules and scoring, SGF, and a computer opponent.
history.2: Dark theme (Crake palette) with a light/dark toggle, plus a tidier header.
history.3: Crake electric-teal palette, stone-click sound, and a richer board.
history.5: Faster, stronger bot and a purpose-built tablet (landscape) layout.
history.6: Fail-safe update install (browser fallback) and a richer wood texture.
history.7: NFC tap-to-share (tap another phone to open Kaya's download page).
history.8: Stronger bot: RAVE search shares each playout across related moves for more purposeful, tougher play at the same speed.
history.9: Tighter bot: prunes pointless self-atari moves before searching, so it never slams a stone into nothing and reads deeper.
history.10: The computer ends decided games gracefully: when you pass and it is settled and ahead, it passes back instead of playing on.
history.11: A more handsome board: a proper goban frame with a heavier outer border and hairline inner lines, scaled to the board size.
history.12: A more tactical opponent: it now values captures, threats, and rescues by group size, so it goes after whole groups and defends its big ones.
history.13: The About screen now shows the real installed version, so every update is visible on the phone.
